description: This file contains SCSS mixins for styling form validation states, focus states, and sizing of form controls in a web application's theme.

methods.name: form-control-validation
methods.description: Mixin for styling validation states of form controls, labels, and help texts with customizable colors.

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: Mixin for styling focus states of form controls with customizable border color.

methods.name: input-size
methods.description: Mixin to define size, padding, font, and border-radius for form input elements, including select and textarea.
